name: smwgraphics-bomberman-ii-intro-cutscene
title: Bomberman II - Intro Cutscene
description:
The city seen in the opening sequence of Bomberman II for the NES.

Includes a church cross that was removed from the international releases, due to Nintendo's censorship back then. Thanks to NES Boy216 for telling me about this.

There's four palettes included:
- FCEUX colors;
- FCEUX, but with a lighter outline;
- NES colors;
- NES colors but with a lighter outline;

Pick the one you like the most. Personally, I think that the ones with lighter outlines work the best with SMW style.

The colors and outline are easy enough to edit. If you want to remove the cross, for some reason, delete the last two 8x8 tiles in the provided bin file.

A good fit for retro themed town levels.
